```{r}
  dplyr::select(-celltypist_cell_label, -celltypist_conf_score) %>%
  left_join(
    meta_slim %>% dplyr::select(barcode, celltype, celltypist_cell_label),
```

```{r}
df$class<-paste(df$condition, df$celltype, sep="_")
```

# Figures 3C & 3D

```{r}
all_terms_global <- unique(c(edges_npc$term, edges_tbr1$term))

term_col_global <- c(
  "axonogenesis" = "#8fd7d7",
  "dendrite development" = "#00b0be",
  "endoplasmic reticulum to Golgi vesicle-mediated transport" = "#ff8ca1",
  "ER overload response" = "#C8A2C8",
  "neural precursor cell proliferation" = "#BDD373",
  "postsynapse organization" = "#98C127",
  "regulation of neuron projection development" = "#FFCD8E", 
  "regulation of synapse structure or activity"="#FF9D3A"
)

missing_terms <- setdiff(all_terms_global, names(term_col_global))
if (length(missing_terms) > 0) {
  warning("Missing colors for: ", paste(missing_terms, collapse = ", "))
  term_col_global[missing_terms] <- "grey80"
}

term_col_global <- term_col_global[unique(c(names(term_col_global), all_terms_global))]
term_col_global <- term_col_global[!is.na(names(term_col_global))]

plot_go_chord <- function(edges, go_genes, term_col_global, file = NULL,
                          width_mm = 40, height_mm = 40, res = 600) {
  
  all_terms <- unique(edges$term)
  all_genes <- unique(edges$genes)
  
  gene_meta <- go_genes %>%
    filter(gene %in% all_genes)
  
  lim <- max(abs(gene_meta$avg_log2FC), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
    seq(-lim, lim, length.out = 5),
    diverging_palette(5)
  )
  
  gene_col <- setNames(
    col_fun(gene_meta$avg_log2FC),
    gene_meta$gene
  )
  
  missing_genes <- setdiff(all_genes, names(gene_col))
  if (length(missing_genes) > 0) {
    gene_col[missing_genes] <- "grey80"
  }
  
  term_col <- term_col_global[all_terms]
  names(term_col) <- all_terms
  
  grid.col <- c(term_col, gene_col)
  sector_order <- c(all_terms, all_genes)
  
  draw_fun <- function() {
    circos.clear()
    circos.par(
      start.degree = 90,
      gap.after = c(
        rep(1, length(all_terms) - 1), 6,
        rep(1, length(all_genes) - 1), 6
      ),
      track.margin = c(0, 0),
      cell.padding = c(0, 20, 0, 0),
      canvas.xlim = c(-1.5, 1.5),
      canvas.ylim = c(-1.5, 1.5),
      points.overflow.warning = FALSE
    )
    
    chordDiagram(
      x = edges,
      order = sector_order,
      grid.col = grid.col,
      transparency = 0.2,
      annotationTrack = "grid",
      annotationTrackHeight = 0.03,
      directional = 0,
      link.sort = FALSE,
      link.lwd = 0.2,
      link.border = NA,
      link.arr.type = "none"
    )
    
    circos.trackPlotRegion(
      track.index = 1,
      panel.fun = function(x, y) {
        sector.name <- get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")
        if (sector.name %in% all_genes) {
          circos.text(
            x = get.cell.meta.data("xcenter"),
            y = get.cell.meta.data("ylim")[2] + 0.05,
            labels = sector.name,
            facing = "clockwise",
            niceFacing = TRUE,
            adj = c(0, 0.5),
            cex = 1
          )
        }
      },
      bg.border = NA
    )
  }
  
  if (!is.null(file)) {
    png(
      filename = file,
      width = width_mm,
      height = height_mm,
      units = "mm",
      res = res,
      pointsize = 5,
      bg = "transparent"
    )
    draw_fun()
    dev.off()
  } else {
    draw_fun()
  }
}

plot_go_chord(
  edges = edges_npc,
  go_genes = go_genes_npc,
  term_col_global = term_col_global,
  file = "../Figures/Figure3C.png"
)

plot_go_chord(
  edges = edges_tbr1,
  go_genes = go_genes_tbr1,
  term_col_global = term_col_global,
  file = "../Figures/Figure3D.png"
)
```

# Figure 3E & Supp. Fig 3D

```{r}
df<-readRDS("../data/PerezFernandez_2026.rds")
DefaultAssay(df)<-"RNA"
```

```{r}
df_fused <- subset(df, condition == "FUSED")
df_coctrl <- subset(df, condition == "CO")
df_roctrl <- subset (df, condition == "RO")
```

```{r}
dfs <- list(
  FUSED = df_fused,
  CO    = df_coctrl,
  RO    = df_roctrl
)

CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.human

for (tmp in names(dfs)) {
  obj <- dfs[[tmp]]
  
  Idents(obj) <- "celltype"
  
  data.input <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")
  rownames(data.input) <- toupper(rownames(data.input))
  
  cellchat_obj <- createCellChat(
    object = data.input,
    meta = obj@meta.data,
    group.by = "celltype"
  )
  
  cellchat_obj@DB <- CellChatDB
  
  cellchat_obj <- cellchat_obj %>%
    subsetData() %>% 
    identifyOverExpressedGenes() %>%
    identifyOverExpressedInteractions()
  
  cellchat_obj@idents <- droplevels(cellchat_obj@idents)
  
  cellchat_obj <- cellchat_obj %>%
    computeCommunProb() %>%
    filterCommunication(min.cells = 100) %>%
    computeCommunProbPathway() %>%
    aggregateNet() %>%
    netAnalysis_computeCentrality(slot.name = "netP") %>%
    identifyCommunicationPatterns(pattern = "outgoing", k = 5) %>%
    identifyCommunicationPatterns(pattern = "incoming", k = 5)
    
  
  saveRDS(cellchat_obj, paste0("../data/Cellchat_", tmp, ".rds"))
}
```

## Cell proportion

```{r}
telen_cells <- c(
  "Telen_NPC",
  "Telen_IPC",
  "Telen_NBL",
  "TBR1+_Neurons",
  "SATB2+_Neurons"

cell_counts <- df@meta.data %>%
  filter(condition %in% c("CO", "FUSED"),
         celltype %in% telen_cells) %>%
  mutate(
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("CO", "FUSED")),
    celltype = factor(celltype, levels = telen_cells)
  ) %>%
  group_by(condition, celltype) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage_total = n / sum(n) * 100,
    percentage_telen = n / sum(n) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

cell_counts_clean <- cell_counts %>%
  mutate(
```

```{r}
mat_to_long <- function(mat, dataset, pattern) {
  df <- as.data.frame(mat)
  df$pathway <- rownames(mat)

  df_long <- pivot_longer(
    df,
    cols = -pathway,
    names_to = "celltype",
    values_to = "strength"
  )

  df_long$dataset <- dataset
  df_long$pattern <- pattern

  df_long %>%
    dplyr::select(dataset, pattern, pathway, celltype, strength)
}

mat_to_wide <- function(mat) {
  df <- as.data.frame(mat)
  df$pathway <- rownames(mat)
  df %>%
    dplyr::select(pathway, everything())
}

out_CO_mat    <- ht_out_CO@matrix
out_FUSED_mat <- ht_out_FUSED@matrix
in_CO_mat     <- ht_in_CO@matrix
in_FUSED_mat  <- ht_in_FUSED@matrix

out_CO_long    <- mat_to_long(out_CO_mat, "CO_CTRL", "outgoing")
out_FUSED_long <- mat_to_long(out_FUSED_mat, "FUSED", "outgoing")
in_CO_long     <- mat_to_long(in_CO_mat, "CO_CTRL", "incoming")
in_FUSED_long  <- mat_to_long(in_FUSED_mat, "FUSED", "incoming")

role_long <- bind_rows(
  out_CO_long,
  out_FUSED_long,
  in_CO_long,
  in_FUSED_long
)

out_CO_wide    <- mat_to_wide(out_CO_mat)
out_FUSED_wide <- mat_to_wide(out_FUSED_mat)
in_CO_wide     <- mat_to_wide(in_CO_mat)
in_FUSED_wide  <- mat_to_wide(in_FUSED_mat)

comm_CO    <- subsetCommunication(cellchat_CO_CTRL)
comm_FUSED <- subsetCommunication(cellchat_FUSED)
wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(wb, "pathway_union")
writeData(wb, "pathway_union", data.frame(pathway = pathway.union))

addWorksheet(wb, "incoming_CO_wide")

addWorksheet(wb, "incoming_FUSED_wide")
writeData(wb, "incoming_FUSED_wide", in_FUSED_wide)

addWorksheet(wb, "role_long")

saveWorkbook(
```

```{r}
keep_present <- function(x, obj) {
  present <- intersect(unique(x), rownames(obj))
  missing <- setdiff(unique(x), present)
  if (length(missing)) message("Not detected, dropped: ",
                               paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  present
}
```

```{r}
library(scales)

# floor the ramp at 0; handle modules whose max is 0 or negative
score_limits <- function(v) {
  hi <- suppressWarnings(max(v, na.rm = TRUE))
  if (!is.finite(hi) || hi <= 0) hi <- 1   # all-zero / all-negative module -> uniform gray
  c(0, hi)
}

plot_score <- function(obj, feat, pal = rna_palette_2(10), red = "umap_hvg") {
  FeaturePlot(obj, features = feat, reduction = red, pt.size = 0.1) &
    NoAxes() & ggtitle(NULL) & NoLegend() &
    scale_color_gradientn(colors = pal,
                          limits = score_limits(obj@meta.data[[feat]]),
                          oob    = scales::squish)
}

patchwork::wrap_plots(
  lapply(reg_score_cols, function(f) plot_score(tmp, f)), ncol = 4)

for (i in seq_along(reg_score_cols)) {
  p <- plot_score(tmp, reg_score_cols[i])
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("../Figures/REV_", names(reg_score_sets)[i], ".png"),
    plot     = p,
    width    = 45*3,
    height   = 45*3,
    units    = "mm",
    dpi      = 600
  )
}
```

# Pseudotime

```{r params}
GRP_VAR <- "sample"    
GRP_A   <- "CO_CTRL" 
GRP_B   <- "CO_FUSED" 

LINEAGE <- c("Telen_NPC", "Telen_IPC", "Telen_NBL", "TBR1+_Neurons", "SATB2+_Neurons")

# monocle3 always reads the reduction literally named "umap"; the figures use
# "umap_hvg", so it is copied onto a working object before conversion.
MONOCLE_UMAP <- "umap_hvg"
```

```{r subset}
keep_cells <- colnames(df)[df$celltype %in% LINEAGE &
                           df$orig.ident %in% c(GRP_A, GRP_B)]
tel <- subset(df, cells = keep_cells)

tel$celltype <- factor(as.character(tel$celltype), levels = LINEAGE)
tel$orig.ident      <- factor(as.character(tel$orig.ident), levels = c(GRP_A, GRP_B))

DefaultAssay(tel) <- "RNA"
tel <- NormalizeData(tel, verbose = FALSE)
```

## Trajectory (monocle3)

```{r monocle-build, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(monocle3)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(igraph)

tel_m <- tel
tel_m[["umap"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
  embeddings = Embeddings(tel, reduction = MONOCLE_UMAP),
  key        = "UMAP_",
  assay      = DefaultAssay(tel))

cds <- SeuratWrappers::as.cell_data_set(tel_m)
cds <- monocle3::cluster_cells(cds, reduction_method = "UMAP")
cds <- monocle3::learn_graph(cds, use_partition = FALSE, close_loop = FALSE)

root_cells <- colnames(tel_m)[tel_m$celltype == "Telen_NPC"]

closest_vertex <- cds@principal_graph_aux[["UMAP"]]$pr_graph_cell_proj_closest_vertex
closest_vertex <- as.matrix(closest_vertex[colnames(cds), ])
root_vertex <- igraph::V(monocle3::principal_graph(cds)[["UMAP"]])$name[
  as.numeric(names(which.max(table(closest_vertex[root_cells, ]))))]

cds <- monocle3::order_cells(cds, root_pr_nodes = root_vertex)
tel$pseudotime <- monocle3::pseudotime(cds)[colnames(tel)]
```

```{r monocle-plot-stripped, fig.asp=0.45}

    legend.position = "none",

  )

p1 <- monocle3::plot_cells(cds, color_cells_by = "celltype",
                           label_groups_by_cluster = FALSE,

```

```{r princurve, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(princurve))

emb_p <- Embeddings(tel, reduction = "pca")
emb_p <- emb_p[, seq_len(min(20, ncol(emb_p))), drop = FALSE]

ref_rows <- which(tel$orig.ident == GRP_A)

# Initialise on the reference stage ordering so the curve runs
# NPC -> IPC -> NBL -> neuron rather than in an arbitrary direction.
pc_fit <- princurve::principal_curve(
  x        = emb_p[ref_rows, , drop = FALSE],
  smoother = "smooth_spline",
  trace    = FALSE)

proj_all <- princurve::project_to_curve(
  x = emb_p,
  s = pc_fit$s[pc_fit$ord, , drop = FALSE])

tel$pt_ref <- proj_all$lambda
stage_rank <- setNames(seq_along(LINEAGE), LINEAGE)
tel$stage_num <- unname(stage_rank[as.character(tel$celltype)])

tel$pt_ref <- (tel$pt_ref - min(tel$pt_ref)) /
              (max(tel$pt_ref) - min(tel$pt_ref))
if (stats::cor(tel$pt_ref, tel$stage_num, method = "spearman") < 0) {
  tel$pt_ref <- 1 - tel$pt_ref
}
```

```{r pt-density-heatmap-strip, fig.asp=0.7}
p <- ggplot(tel@meta.data, aes(pt_ref, fill = celltype)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60) +
  facet_grid(celltype ~ orig.ident, scales = "free_y", axes = "all") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = RPF_palette_2, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text    = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.line    = element_line(colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks   = element_line(colour = "black"),
    strip.text.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_blank()
  )
p

ggsave(
  filename = "../Figures/Pseudotime_histogram.png",
  plot     = p,
  width    = 105,
  height   = 80,
  units    = "mm",
  dpi      = 600
)
```
